families.decision: Organic, pasture-raised poultry or pork from a named small local farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; pasture-raised plus Real Organic is the top rung.
Pick a named small local farm on the pack or counter sign.
Read USDA Organic for feed; pasture-raised alone names outdoor rearing.
Check the ingredient line for plain meat, or meat with salt and named seasonings.

families.decision: Organic pasture-raised eggs, corn- and soy-free, from a named small farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic plus pasture-raised; organic alone is the floor.
Check for the Real Organic seal to back outdoor access to vegetated ground.
Read corn-free and soy-free on a carton naming a small local farm.
Pick a refrigerated carton with clean, uncracked shells.

sources.name: Printed corn-free and soy-free feed claims

families.decision: Organic pasture-raised meat, simply prepared, from a named small local farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic plus Real Organic on pasture-raised meat.
Pick a named small local farm on the pack or counter sign.
Read the shortest ingredient list with named meat, fat, salt and seasonings.
Skip nitrite, nitrate or celery curing ingredients, even on 'uncured' packs.

sources.name: Celery powder as a curing ingredient

rotisserie_chicken.decision: Organic pasture-raised rotisserie chicken, with salt and named herbs.
rotisserie_chicken.delta: Roasted whole bird; skip phosphate or starch in the seasoning.

chicken_cuts_basics.decision: Organic pasture-raised, soy-free whole chicken, air-chilled.
chicken_cuts_basics.delta: Whole bird first, then bone-in thighs; air-chilled on the pack.

turkey_whole.delta: Whole, unbasted turkey; skip any added-solution percentage beside the name.

ground_turkey.decision: Organic pasture-raised ground turkey, breast and thigh meat only.
ground_turkey.delta: Breast-and-thigh mince, with the cuts named on the pack.

chicken_breast.decision: Organic pasture-raised, air-chilled breast with bone and skin.
chicken_breast.delta: Bone-in, skin-on breast rather than boneless, skinless fillets.

poultry_duck.decision: Organic pasture-raised, soy-free whole duck with skin on.
poultry_duck.delta: Whole duck with skin intact; plain raw duck rather than confit.

poultry_chicken_wings.decision: Organic pasture-raised chicken wings, air-chilled and uncoated.
poultry_chicken_wings.delta: Whole wings or split flats and drumettes; no breading or sauce.

egg_labels.decision: Organic pasture-raised hen eggs, with corn-free and soy-free on the carton.
egg_labels.delta: Hen shells may be white, brown or blue; color follows breed.

egg_duck_quail.decision: Organic pasture-raised duck or quail eggs, with corn- and soy-free feed named.
egg_duck_quail.delta: Duck or quail named on the carton.

deli_meat_uncured.decision: Organic pasture-raised whole roasted meat, sliced at the counter.
deli_meat_uncured.delta: Whole roasted joint sliced to order, rather than a chopped or formed deli loaf.

bacon.decision: Organic pasture-raised bacon, dry-cured with salt and wood-smoked.
bacon.delta: Belly slices with dry-cured wording; wood-smoked without liquid smoke in the ingredients.

hot_dogs.decision: Organic, 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef hot dogs with a short ingredient list.
hot_dogs.delta: AGA grassfed seal for the beef; skip mechanically separated poultry, starch and phosphates.

ham.decision: Organic pasture-raised whole-muscle ham, dry-cured with pork and salt.
ham.delta: Whole-leg dry-cured ham; check ready-to-eat or cook-before-eating wording.

turkey_bacon.decision: Organic pasture-raised turkey bacon, with named turkey meat and no added sugar.
turkey_bacon.delta: Turkey cut named beside 'bacon'; skip sugar, dextrose and mechanically separated turkey.

cured_pork.decision: Organic pasture-raised whole pork cuts, dry-cured with salt.
cured_pork.delta: Leg or belly named on the pack; whole-muscle slices rather than ground salami.

deli_liverwurst_pate.decision: Organic pasture-raised liver pâté or liverwurst, with butter or named animal fat.
deli_liverwurst_pate.delta: Liver first; butter or named animal fat, without starch or seed oil.

groups.title: Whole chicken, breasts and wings
groups.why_same: Same organic and pasture seals, farm label, plain-meat ingredient check and air-chilled wording; only the cut changes.

groups.title: Whole turkey and duck
groups.why_same: Both use the organic and pasture checks, a whole raw bird with skin, and the added-solution label check.

groups.title: Hen, duck and quail eggs
groups.why_same: Same organic and pasture seals, separate feed claims, farm name, refrigerated carton and intact-shell check.

groups.title: Salt-cured ham and whole pork cuts
groups.why_same: Same organic pasture sourcing, whole-muscle form, pork-and-salt ingredient screen and cooking-status label.
